style: Use case: illustration-story. Retell Hercules as a graphic novel. Art Style: Modern Korean Webtoon Slice-of-Life Style. Clean polished linework, smooth rounded edges, soft digital finish, warm pastel colors, gentle gradients, light shading, bright friendly emotionally relatable atmosphere. Large expressive eyes, soft facial features, small rounded mouths, subtle blush. Focus on facial expressions and body language. Simple lightly detailed ancient Greek homes, villages and mythological landscapes rather than modern schools. Consistent Hercules: curly chestnut hair, warm brown eyes, cream tunic, terracotta sash, sandals; as adult youthful broad shouldered, lion-skin cape after lion task. Child friendly, no gore. One landscape standalone scene, no panels, no lettering or speech bubbles, no watermark. Scene:
